protocol: world_model_rollout_v1: Block-12 minimal experiment. Discrete nonlinear dynamics s'=(s*s+3) mod N. complete learns the full transition table (rollout exact forever); linear_approx fits s'~a*s+b (drifts on nonlinear dynamics); partial sees half the states (fails at unseen states). Criterion: complete rollout error <= 0.05 and >= 0.3 lower than both controls -- long-horizon stability requires a genuine (complete) dynamics model.
